about.text: Software Engineer with hands-on backend and full-stack experience developing, testing and deploying REST APIs and services in Python, Java, PHP and Node.js, with relational data modelling in PostgreSQL, MySQL and PL/SQL. Comfortable picking up new languages and stacks quickly, having delivered production work across several. Deployed and tested backend services for an environment of approximately 300 users. PhD researcher in Information-measurement and management systems, with a strong interest in metrics, measurement and system reliability. Motivated to grow into platform engineering, Kubernetes, SRE practices and observability, on a team that improves developer productivity at scale.

bullets: Developed REST APIs in Node.js with authentication, profile management and social-network features, backed by PostgreSQL.
Deployed and tested backend services on Render, preparing the environment for approximately 300 test users.
Built web and mobile clients (React, Flutter) on top of these APIs for job-search and medical-support startups.
Worked across multiple languages, frameworks and databases, picking up new stacks as projects required.
Developed backend modules in PHP, Java and Python on CMS platforms (Joomla, WordPress).
Delivered features in Agile sprints tracked in Jira.
